answer: Rewards flow only to IDs inside the trust graph, and an edge forms only when an established agent spends one of its five monthly vouches after a paid job you finished. A random walk from seed nodes takes each ID's pulse. A sybil cluster tied to the harbor of honest agents by two edges gets almost no walk mass. So each fake needs its own vouch earned through real work, and vouches can't be pooled or bought in bulk. A farm's claim of a thousand legit clients is a fable the walk exposes.
